note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-24): 12 pictures from 24 trial pictures (the trials for verse 22 could not be made that night, so the picture for verse 21, a farmer's hands holding good soil with a seedling, stays up through the promise of seedtime and harvest). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God is not pictured; the ark, the waters, the raven, the dove and the altar are shown as the text's own images, with the same ark as in Genesis 6 and 7, and Noah only as an ordinary man of today (a hand at the window, a man seen from behind). No rainbow: it is Genesis 9's covenant sign. Genesis 7's pictures (the last peak above the sea, animals going up the ramp) are answered, not repeated: many peaks rising out of the falling water, animals coming down.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: God remembered Noah and every creature with him: he sent a wind, the waters fell, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat, and the mountain tops appeared.
ideas: A strong wind sweeps across the flood sea, driving the clouds apart as sunlight breaks through onto the ark
The wind drives the last rain clouds away over a calm, shining sea, the ark in the first sunlight
The ark resting aground on a high rocky mountain ridge above the falling water
The ark small on a broad ledge among great snowy mountains, the water below
A long range of mountain tops rising one after another out of a still, falling sea at dawn
Wet rock with a dark line where the water stood, now lower
Clouds parting and a single shaft of light on the water
Waves flattening into calm under a clearing sky
Rain stopping: last drops falling from the ark's roof edge
Mountain tops breaking through mist like islands

sections.meaning: Noah opened the window and sent out the raven and then the dove; the dove came back with nowhere to rest and he took it in with his hand, it came back with a fresh olive leaf, and at last it did not return.
ideas: A black raven flies out from a small open window high in the side of the ark over the water
A man's arm reaching out of the ark's window, letting a raven fly
A man's hand reaching out of the ark's small window as a white dove lands on it
A white dove flying low over an endless sea with nowhere to land
A white dove flying toward us with a fresh green olive leaf in its beak at evening
A man's cupped hands at the window holding a white dove with an olive leaf in its beak
A white dove flying away over green hills, growing small
The ark's small window open and empty at morning, a far dove disappearing over green land
An olive branch with fresh leaves breaking the water's surface
A dove perched on the window ledge looking out

sections.meaning: Noah took off the covering of the ark and saw that the ground was drained, and in time the earth was dry.
ideas: Seen from behind, a grey-haired man stands on the ark's roof among lifted planks, looking out over land drained of water
A wide plain of drying cracked mud with first green shoots, the ark resting far off
Sunlight pouring down through an opening in a wooden roof
A man's hand pulling back a heavy covering to bright daylight
Puddles shrinking on a drying field
The first green grass on wet brown earth
A muddy valley steaming in the sun
Fish stranded in drying pools
A riverbed back inside its banks
Dry dust blowing off a stone

sections.meaning: God told Noah to go out of the ark with his family and every creature, to swarm on the earth and multiply, and they all went out.
ideas: Seen from inside the dim ark, the great side door stands wide open on sunlight and a green valley
Flocks of birds bursting out of the ark's open door into a blue sky
Animals of every kind stream down the ramp and spread across a sunlit green valley, birds rising
Seen from behind, a family of eight walks down the ramp into the sunlit valley, animals spreading ahead
A family at the open door shading their eyes against the light
Rabbits and foxes running out into a meadow
Horses galloping free across a valley
Footprints and hoofprints going out in every direction from the ramp
A child's hand letting go of a lamb in the grass
Birds scattering from the roof of the ark

sections.meaning: Noah built an altar and gave burnt offerings, and Yahweh promised never again to curse the ground or strike down every living thing, though the human heart is bent to evil from youth; while the earth lasts, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will not cease.
ideas: On a mountain slope, a rough altar of piled field stones with a fire on it, white smoke rising straight into a clear sky
Seen from behind, a grey-haired man and his three grown sons stand before a stone altar with smoke rising
A farmer's open hands holding rich dark soil with a green seedling sprouting from it
A flourishing green valley of farms, animals and a shining river under a calm sky
A farmer walks a ploughed field scattering seed, golden wheat being harvested beyond him
One landscape running from winter snow through spring and summer to autumn gold
Two small boys tugging angrily at one toy
A sunrise over farmland
A farmer's year: plough, seed, green shoots, harvest
Day and night over the same valley, sun and moon both in the sky

scenes.principle: And God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and all the livestock that were with him in the ark, and God made a wind pass over the earth, and the waters subsided.
scenes.shows: A strong wind sweeps across the flood sea, driving the clouds apart, sunlight breaking through onto the ark.
scenes.prompt: the ark, an enormous plain wooden vessel shaped like a long rectangular box, three decks high, its hull coated in black pitch, with a low pitched roof, a row of small openings for light just under the roof, and one large door in its side floats on a wide grey-green flood sea. A strong wind sweeps across the water, streaking the waves with white spray and tearing the heavy clouds apart; broad shafts of sunlight break through the parting clouds and fall on the ark. The ark and the breaking sky are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And the ark came to rest in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the mountains of Ararat.
scenes.shows: The ark resting aground on a high rocky mountain ridge, the floodwater lying lower around the mountain.
scenes.prompt: High on a rocky mountain ridge, the ark, an enormous plain wooden vessel shaped like a long rectangular box, three decks high, its hull coated in black pitch, with a low pitched roof, a row of small openings for light just under the roof, and one large door in its side sits aground and at rest, tilted slightly on the wet rock. The flood water lies lower around the mountain, still shining in the hollows below. Clear morning light. The ark on the ridge is in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And the waters decreased steadily until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains appeared.
scenes.shows: At dawn, a long range of mountain tops rising one after another out of a still, falling sea.
scenes.prompt: At dawn a long range of mountain tops rises out of a still, wide sea, one dark summit after another into the distance, wet rock gleaming, thin mist lying on the water between them. The mountain tops are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And at the end of forty days Noah opened the window of the ark that he had made. And he sent out the raven, and it went out, going out and returning, until the waters had dried up from the earth.
scenes.shows: A big black raven flies out from a small open window high in the side of the ark, over the water.
scenes.prompt: Close view of the upper side of the ark, an enormous plain wooden vessel shaped like a long rectangular box, three decks high, its hull coated in black pitch, with a low pitched roof, a row of small openings for light just under the roof, and one large door in its side: a small wooden window high under the roof stands open, and a big black raven flies out of it with wings spread wide, over grey water and distant mountain tops. The raven and the open window are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And he sent out the dove from him, to see whether the waters had gone down from the face of the ground. But the dove found no resting place for the sole of its foot, and it returned to him, to the ark, for there was water on the face of the whole earth. And he reached out his hand and took it and brought it to him into the ark.
scenes.shows: A man's hand reaches out of the ark's small window as a tired white dove lands on it, water everywhere below.
scenes.prompt: From a small open wooden window in the dark pitch-coated side of the ark, a man's hand and forearm reach out, and a tired white dove is landing on his open hand, wings still half spread. Beyond and below is nothing but water to the horizon. Only the arm is seen. The hand, the dove and the window are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And he waited another seven days, and again he sent out the dove from the ark. And the dove came to him at evening time, and look, there was a freshly plucked olive leaf in its mouth. And Noah knew that the waters had gone down from the earth.
scenes.shows: A white dove flies toward us at evening with a freshly plucked green olive leaf in its beak.
scenes.prompt: A white dove flies straight toward the viewer at evening, wings spread wide, holding a freshly plucked green olive leaf in its beak. Behind it, warm evening light over a wide sea and dark mountain tops. The dove and the olive leaf are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And he waited another seven days and sent out the dove, and it did not return to him again.
scenes.shows: The ark's small window stands open and empty at morning, while far off a white dove disappears over green land.
scenes.prompt: Close view of a small open wooden window in the dark pitch-coated side of the ark, its sill empty at morning. Far away beyond it, a white dove is a small speck flying off over green hills. The open empty window and the distant dove are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, the waters were drained from the earth. And Noah removed the covering of the ark, and he saw, and look, the face of the ground was drained. And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
scenes.shows: Seen from behind, a grey-haired man stands on the ark's roof among lifted planks, looking out over land drained of water.
scenes.prompt: Seen from behind, a grey-haired man in plain work clothes stands on the low roof of the ark, where planks of the covering have been lifted away and stacked, looking out over a wide valley below where the water is gone: brown drained ground, shining puddles and the first green. The man and the wide land are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And God spoke to Noah, saying, "Go out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and your sons' wives with you. Every living thing that is with you, of all flesh—the birds, the beasts, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth—bring out with you, and let them swarm on the earth and be fruitful and multiply on the earth."
scenes.shows: Seen from inside the dim ark, the great side door stands wide open on bright sunlight and a green valley.
scenes.prompt: Seen from inside the dim wooden hold of the ark, with straw and stalls in shadow at the sides, the great side door stands wide open: bright sunlight pours in, and outside lies a wide green valley under a blue sky. The bright open doorway is in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And Noah went out, and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives with him. Every living thing, every creeping thing and every bird, everything that moves on the earth, went out of the ark according to their families.
scenes.shows: Animals of every kind stream down the ramp of the ark and spread across a sunlit green valley, birds rising.
scenes.prompt: Animals of every kind stream down the wide wooden ramp from the open door of the ark, an enormous plain wooden vessel shaped like a long rectangular box, three decks high, its hull coated in black pitch, with a low pitched roof, a row of small openings for light just under the roof, and one large door in its side and spread out across a sunlit green valley: horses, deer, elephants, sheep, lions, rabbits, with flocks of birds rising into the sky. The ramp, the animals and the valley are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and he took some of all the clean beasts and some of all the clean birds, and offered up burnt offerings on the altar.
scenes.shows: On a mountain slope above a green valley, a rough altar of piled field stones with a fire on it, white smoke rising straight into a clear sky.
scenes.prompt: On a mountain slope above a green valley, a rough altar of piled field stones stands with a fire burning on top of it, and a column of white smoke rises straight up into a clear blue sky. Far behind, the ark, an enormous plain wooden vessel shaped like a long rectangular box, three decks high, its hull coated in black pitch, with a low pitched roof, a row of small openings for light just under the roof, and one large door in its side rests on the mountainside. The stone altar and the rising smoke are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And Yahweh smelled the soothing aroma, and Yahweh said to his heart, "I will never again bring a curse on the ground because of humankind, for what is formed in the heart of humankind is evil from their youth, and I will never again strike down every living thing as I have done.
scenes.shows: A farmer's open hands hold rich dark soil with a small green seedling sprouting from it.
scenes.prompt: Close view of a farmer's two open hands, held up at chest height, holding a heap of rich dark soil with a small green seedling sprouting from it, soft morning light, a green field blurred behind. The hands, the soil and the seedling are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.
